title: Vector space
summary: A vector space supports vector addition and scalar multiplication under compatibility laws.

content.plain: A vector space supports vector addition and scalar multiplication under compatibility laws.
content.exact: A vector space V over field F is an abelian group under + with an action F×V→V satisfying distributive, associative, and identity axioms.
content.example: ℝ² is a vector space over ℝ.
content.caveat: The scalar field is part of the structure.
